entities.summary: The MEarth Project is a NSF-funded project in the United States. It is a robotic exoplanet observatory that is part of the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory on Mount Hopkins in Arizona. The project monitors the brightness of thousands of red dwarf stars with the goal of finding transiting planets. As red dwarf stars are small, any transiting planet blocks a larger proportion of starlight than transits around a Sun-like star would, allowing smaller planets to be detected through ground-based observations.
